Info

Classifier evaluating microcontroller ASCII protocol responses for waypoint moves and action completions.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.classifier.status.motion_status_classifier.MotionStatusClassifier(response_parser: IResponseParser)[source]¶

Bases: object

Evaluates ASCII protocol packets against waypoint motion and action execution criteria.

It defines:

attributes:
_response_parser - The parser for decoding raw ASCII wire packets.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes MotionStatusClassifier with response parser.
is_move_done - Checks if packet confirms completion of a waypoint move.
is_move_failed - Checks if packet confirms failure of a waypoint move.
is_action_done - Checks if packet confirms completion of a tool or wait action.
is_complete - Checks if packet confirms completion of either a move or action.
_response_parser: IResponseParser¶
